integrity: The theorem is analytic; exact-rational enumerations are supporting finite checks, not a substitute for proof. The published-coverage assessment is limited to the material inspected; no claim of independent audit is made.
scientific_limitations: Single uniformly chosen seed, one perfect pre-epidemic vaccine, independent homogeneous bond-percolation transmission, finite broom trees with k>=2; expectation only; does not establish an equivalent claim for arbitrary continuous-time SIR, other networks, or multiple vaccines.
title: A single irreversible vaccination-site transition on broom trees
